labels.title: Commercial credit catalog
labels.intro: Publish future package and monthly-plan offers. Existing accepted terms remain unchanged. Publication does not activate payment providers or sales.
labels.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again to recover the original publication.
labels.unavailable: Catalog unavailable or retry storage inaccessible. A pending publication must be recovered with its original terms.
labels.rejected: Publication rejected. Check versions, product references and the future UTC start. An unresolved earlier reply retains its original command.
labels.reload: Load current catalog / recover pending publication
labels.pending: Publication response unresolved. Retry the exact original command; no automatic publication occurs.
labels.completeCatalog: This replaces the complete new-sale selection at its effective start. Omitted offers are withdrawn from new sales. An empty catalog withdraws all offers; existing subscriptions are preserved.
labels.versionsHelp: Keep unchanged product/offer versions. Changed names, credits, prices or markets require new versions. Use operation purchase or subscription; credit quantities remain exact in the editor.
labels.offerHelp: Reference an included product ID and version. Countries: comma-separated two-letter codes. Currency: BRL or USD. Interval: month for subscriptions, empty for non-expiring packages. Provider availability is checked separately at checkout.
labels.name: Name
labels.month: Monthly; credits expire at period end
